VI.description: Waits until the thread of hWnd (LabVIEW's UI thread) has handled the messages posted to it so far\2C at most about 1 s. LabVIEW drops and reorders key messages that arrive in a burst - twelve posted Backspace key-downs became one\2C and the generated WM_CHAR of a key-down landed behind characters posted after it (measured) - and decides how to read a button-up from the mouse capture its button-down set up (RemoteVI Mouse Captured.vi). So RemoteVI Post Input.vi posts each message only after LabVIEW has finished the one before. Mechanism\3A a SENT message is delivered when the receiving thread next looks into its queue\2C before any posted message is returned\2C so the first WM_NULL sent with user32 SendMessageTimeoutW.vi returns once LabVIEW has fetched the queued posts\2C and the second once it has come back for more - after handling them. SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG\2C 500 ms each\3B a timeout (a busy or hung UI thread) is not an error\2C the caller just goes on. Sent messages are also handled inside LabVIEW's modal loops (popup menus\2C mouse tracking)\2C so this never deadlocks. An incoming error skips the work.

Control.description: The window the messages were posted to.
Nothing is sent when this carries an error.

Indicator.description: error in or the errors of the DLL calls.
